item.title: Self-Hosted Consul Backup and Recovery: Built-In Snapshot vs consul-backinator vs consul-snapshot
item.description: Consul has become the go-to solution for service discovery, health checking, and distributed key-value storage across dynamic infrastructure. But as your Consul clusters grow to manage hundreds of services and thousands of KV entries, a robust backup and recovery strategy becomes critical. A corrupted Consul state can take down your entire service mesh in seconds.
